lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur saagar gun naam kaa mai tis dekhan kaa chaau ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Ocean of Virtue of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have such a yearning to see Him!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: hau tis bin ghaRee na jeevaoo bin dekhe mar jaau ||6||
lines.translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant. If I do not see Him, I die. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu machhulee vin paaneeai rahai na kitai upaai ||
lines.translation: As the fish cannot survive at all without water,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har bin sa(n)t na jeevaee bin har naamai mar jaai ||7||
lines.translation: the Saint cannot live without the Lord. Without the Lord's Name, he dies. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai satigur setee pirahaRee kiu gur bin jeevaa maau ||
lines.translation: I am so much in love with my True Guru! How could I even live without the Guru, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: mai gurabaanee aadhaar hai gurabaanee laag rahaau ||8||
lines.translation: I have the Support of the Word of the Guru's Bani. Attached to Gurbani, I survive. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam rata(n)n hai gur tuthaa devai maai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel; by the Pleasure of His Will, the Guru has given it, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: mai dhar sache naam kee har naam rahaa liv laai ||9||
lines.translation: The True Name is my only Support. I remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan padaarath naam hai har naamo dei driRaai ||
lines.translation: The wisdom of the Guru is the treasure of the Naam. The Guru implants and enshrines the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jis paraapat so lahai gur charanee laagai aai ||10||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, he alone gets it, who comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: akath kahaanee prem kee ko preetam aakhai aai ||
lines.translation: If only someone would come and tell me the Unspoken Speech of the Love of my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis devaa man aapanaa niv niv laagaa paai ||11||
lines.translation: I would dedicate my mind to him; I would bow down in humble respect, and fall at his feet. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan meraa ek too(n) karataa purakh sujaan ||
lines.translation: You are my only Friend, O my All-knowing, All-powerful Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meet milaaiaa mai sadaa sadaa teraa taan ||12||
lines.translation: You have brought me to meet with my True Guru. Forever and ever, You are my only strength. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur meraa sadaa sadaa naa aavai naa jaai ||
lines.translation: My True Guru, forever and ever, does not come and go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: ohu abinaasee purakh hai sabh mahi rahiaa samaai ||13||
lines.translation: He is the Imperishable Creator Lord; He is permeating and pervading among all. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa saabat poo(n)jee raas ||
lines.translation: I have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name. My facilities and faculties are intact, safe and sound.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧੪॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daragah ma(n)niaa gur poore saabaas ||14||1||2||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am approved and respected in the Court of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has blessed me! ||14||1||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahio bikhiaa kai sa(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: He is entangled in sinful associations;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manahi biaapat anik tara(n)gaa ||1||
lines.translation: his mind is troubled by so very many waves. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man agam agochar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, how can the Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord be found?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kat paaeeai pooran paramesar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan mahi rahiaa biaape ||
lines.translation: He remains entangled in the intoxication of worldly love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: at trisanaa kabahoo nahee dhraape ||2||
lines.translation: His excessive thirst is never quenched. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸਇ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: basai karodh sareer cha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: Anger is the outcaste which hides within his body;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan na soojhai mahaa gubaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: he is in the utter darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਜਰੇ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhramat biaapat jare kivaaraa ||
lines.translation: Afflicted by doubt, the shutters are shut tight;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaan na paaeeai prabh darabaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: he cannot go to God's Court. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa a(n)desaa ba(n)dh paraanaa ||
lines.translation: The mortal is bound and gagged by hope and fear;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: mahal na paavai phirat bigaanaa ||5||
lines.translation: he cannot find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and so he wanders around like a stranger. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal biaadh kai vas kar deenaa ||
lines.translation: He falls under the power of all negative influences;

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: phirat piaas jiu jal bin meenaa ||6||
lines.translation: he wanders around thirsty like a fish out of water. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree ||
lines.translation: I have no clever tricks or techniques;

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ek aas thaakur prabh toree ||7||
lines.translation: You are my only hope, O my Lord God Master. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau benatee sa(n)tan paase ||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the Saints

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: mel laihu naanak aradaase ||8||
lines.translation: - please let me merge and blend with You. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio kripaal saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
lines.translation: God has shown Mercy, and I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tripate pooraa paaiaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is satisfied, finding the Perfect Lord. ||1||Second Pause||1||
